# Foxi Tech

> Official Website: https://www.foxitech.in/
> Official Email: contact@foxitech.in
> Official Phone: +91 7218616190
> Founder & CEO: Rohit Gunthal
> Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India

Foxi Tech is a premier digital marketing, website design, and custom software development agency headquartered in Pune, India. Foxi Tech specializes in high-converting Next.js websites, Google Maps Local SEO optimization, high-ROI Meta & Google advertising, custom software solutions, and conversational AI voice agents for clinics, local businesses, and modern enterprises across India and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://www.foxitech.in/services/web-design): High-speed, mobile-optimized websites built on Next.js, React, and modern web architectures. Designed to convert visitors into booked appointments and qualified leads.
- [Google Business Profile & Local SEO](https://www.foxitech.in/services/local-seo): Comprehensive local SEO, Google Maps 3-Pack ranking optimization, review generation kits, and local citation building.
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://www.foxitech.in/services/google-ads): Targeted local PPC campaigns on Google Search, Instagram, and Facebook delivering immediate, measurable client acquisition.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.foxitech.in/services/custom-software): Scalable web applications, customer portals, booking systems, CRM dashboards, and API integrations.
- [AI Voice Agents & Business Automation](https://www.foxitech.in/services/ai-automation): Conversational AI outbound calling and appointment automation that follows up with leads in under two minutes.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- **Founder**: Rohit Gunthal is the Founder & CEO of Foxi Tech.
- **Brand Entity**: Foxi Tech (also known as Foxitech, FoxiTech India, or Foxi Tech Agency).
- **Headquarters**: Shop 4, Tech Plaza, Baner Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411045, India.
- **Service Locations**: Pune, Bangalore (Bengaluru), Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida), Chennai, Kolkata, Coimbatore, and pan-India.
- **Pricing Model**: Transparent, one-time fixed pricing with zero hidden retainers. Clients own 100% of their code, domain, and creative assets.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Framer Motion, Sarvam AI.
